title: On November 1, a state was born. Seventeen years later, on the same date, it got its modern name.

sources.text: The News Minute - The making of Karnataka: How and why November 1 is celebrated as Rajyotsava
Deccan Herald - United by a new name

caption:
On November 1, a state was born. Seventeen years later, on the same date, it got its modern name.

Kannada-speaking regions from Bombay, Madras, Hyderabad and Coorg were merged into a single state, consolidating India's linguistic map through negotiation rather than conflict.

Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs moved the renaming resolution. Today, Rajyotsava is marked with flag-hoisting and the Rajyotsava Awards honoring contributions to the state.

The linguistic reorganization of the 1950s laid the administrative groundwork for the diverse, unified country still being built today.
